repairs.reason: continuous grass blade crosses Pikachu's extended arm
continuous foreground leaf crosses Eevee's tail

scene.concept: the nostalgic 1999 Jungle expansion and its untamed woodland life
constraints: Keep dense leaves, vines, rocks, and the river in the distance or at the outer edges so the protected subject silhouettes remain readable.

Two long broad jungle-grass blades rise from the near left and bottom foreground and pass naturally in front of Pikachu's extended arm and lower belly, as real foreground vegetation would. Keep its face unobstructed and give Relaxo and Evoli equally convincing ground contact.
scene.lighting: Warm humid daylight filters through the upper-left canopy.
scene.rendering: Use nostalgic hand-painted cel-animation linework, rich but restrained natural greens, and soft layered woodland depth.
scene.setting: The artwork contains a lush late-1990s cel-painted jungle clearing with layered broadleaf canopy, mossy outer rock shelves, distant hanging vines, and a small sunlit river glimpse deep in the background.

pokeapi:official-artwork:133.traits: Match the exact standing Evoli source: warm brown four-legged body with all four feet on the ground, very large pointed ears with dark inner areas, black oval eyes and white highlights, tiny nose and a subtle closed smile. Preserve the jagged cream neck ruff and its large bushy tail rising to image-right with a cream tip. Do not invent red cheek markings, change it to a seated pose or hide its standing legs.

pokeapi:official-artwork:143.traits: Match the exact seated Relaxo source: broad teal-blue body, pointed ears, closed narrow eyes, cream face and enormous round cream belly. Preserve the continuous curved smiling mouth and its two separate small upward white teeth. Both arms extend to the sides and show their small white claws. Both large forward-facing feet retain the brown oval paw pads and exactly the distinct white source toe claws, without extra spikes.

pokeapi:official-artwork:25.traits: Match this exact cheerful Pikachu source pose: two long black-tipped ears, two round dark eyes with white highlights, red cheeks, an open pink mouth, the image-left arm stretched outward, the other bent toward the chest, two small standing feet and one zigzag yellow tail with its brown base. Keep the face and all limb contours source-close. Two long jungle grass blades may naturally pass in front of its extended arm and lower belly; they are foreground scenery, not new body outlines.
